meaning:
συμ-βουλεύω
[in LXX chiefly for יָעַץ ;]
1. to advise, counsel: with dative of person(s), Jhn.18:14; id. before inf., Rev.3:18.
2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: before ἵνα, Mat.26:4 ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr., 157); with inf., Act.9:23.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: we will also reign with Him

elsewhere.note: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.
If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
